II. A writ order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding to the opposite parties not to take any coercive action or to arrest the petitioner in connection with the impugned first information report dated 12.02.2020 lodged as First Information Report No.080 of 2020, under sections- 419, 420, 467, 468 & 471 I.P.C. at Police Station- Bachharawan, District- Raebareli, which is contained as Annexure No.1 to the writ petition, in the interest of justice."
3.

It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the name of the petitioner has not been mentioned in the first information report and he is nowhere connected with the alleged offence and he has been falsely implicated.
4. Learned A.G.A. has informed this Court that the investigation in the offence was carried out and the name of the petitioner has surfaced during the course of the investigation.
The petitioner has absconded and non-bailable warrant has been issued against the petitioner by the learned court concerned.
5. The writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to the petitioner to approach the appropriate Forum.

(Ajai Kumar Srivastava-I, J.) (Sangeeta Chandra, J.) Order Date :- 7.2.2025 cks/-
